Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio

Class AudioTimeline

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio.AudioTimeline
public final class AudioTimeline extends Object
Audio-only project model; it has no dependency on frame rendering or a wall clock.
